ceilingReasons: fixtures are the dataset's own reference OCR, so no OCR error reaches the parser-only numbers (DECISIONS/0003)
development happens against dev/, so bugs a dev-driven fix would have caught on eval/ are already gone (DECISIONS/0004)
modeNote: the headline mode: parse() over committed reference-OCR fixtures in Node, isolating parser quality from OCR quality (PROJECT(1).md §8, DECISIONS/0014 M1)

protocol.matching: order-respecting one-to-one dynamic programming: pair count first, total name similarity second (§8.3)
protocol.itemFieldAgreement: exact normalized-string equality for names and integer equality for amounts and quantities; tau governs pairing only
protocol.moneyGate: on for every published scorer; the off column is the same matcher with §8.2's gate disabled, which is where a wrong price is visible (DECISIONS/0008)

ocr.tier: none — no OCR runs in this mode (DECISIONS/0003)
ocr.imageSource: none — fixtures are text and boxes, not images

notes: confidence floors (0.50 critical / 0.70 warning) run on no cell in this mode: reference OCR supplies 0 scored words, so every receipt takes confidence_unavailable. The floors are declared defaults, not calibrated, and are exercised end-to-end only (DECISIONS/0014 M7.4).
zero_items counts receipts where itemization could not be proven, not parser failures: a single-total slip and a failed parse are the same finding (DECISIONS/0014 M7.1).
the arithmetic_item_sum criticals are charge and tender rows that ticket 05 classified as items, not price-parse errors, and are not cited as accuracy evidence (DECISIONS/0014 M7.2, ticket 20).
detected unit prices are published as two populations — read off the row, and a line total promoted on an assumed qty 1 — never as one number (DECISIONS/0014 M7.3).
item.name is reported from the matcher, matchItems(τ=0.70, money_gate=on). Ticket 05's substring-containment reachability figure is withdrawn from publication (DECISIONS/0014 M5).

datasets.language: Indonesian — out-of-language layout stress, never part of the English headline claim (ADR-010)
datasets.coverage: item name/qty/unitPrice/lineTotal plus subtotal, grandTotal, serviceCharge, discount and taxTotal; no tip and no round-off annotation exists in the pinned snapshot

datasets.language: English — the headline language for the v1 product (ADR-010)
datasets.coverage: grandTotal only: the dataset annotates company/date/address/total and no item, charge or subtotal field, so nothing item-level is scored from it and it cannot produce an item-price number (DECISIONS/0002)
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 as declared in the mirror's dataset card, LICENSE text, and NOTICE; the primary ICDAR host (rrc.cvc.uab.es/?ch=13, registration/consent) was NOT used and primary-source verification was NOT performed
